logic.supported_means: Preliminary eligibility for drafting a reasoned proposal, NOT a final administrative determination
logic.precedence: Confirmed expert subject and scope before legal tests; each input has provenance
logic.multiple_applicable: Retain simultaneous OS/OVOS/EO hypotheses where supported; coordinate rather than force one route
logic.incomplete_facts: Unknown is not false; always propose concrete next evidence action
logic.competence: Separately proven; do not assume local inspectorate authority
logic.document: Selected only after reasoned analysis, never chosen from Classic A/B or fixed catalog
